comments.body:
I'm puzzled by this condition `App.IsElevated || !launchAdmin`. Should it be launchAdmin (without !)?

Edit: And swap the constants

I understand that it's really puzzling but it should be fine.
Reverted to AND condition to improve readability.

```
string eventName = !App.IsElevated && launchAdmin
    ? Constants.ShowHostsAdminSharedEvent()
    : Constants.ShowHostsSharedEvent();
```

- If PT is not elevated but launch hosts elevated is on: launch elevated
- Else: launch normal

Note: if PT is already elevated we launch normal since there is no need to elevate (runas/UAC stuffs)
